% AC-7 / regression fixture.
% Three paragraphs in a 300pt-tall body; trailing \vfill from \bye stretches
% the remaining vertical space so the three first-line baselines stack at
% topskip + n*baselineskip from the body top. Used by
% tests/test_interpreter_output_routine.py::test_vfil_vsize_distributes_body
% to check that our DVI y-coordinates stay within 1 pt of the MiKTeX baseline.
\vsize=300pt
\noindent Para1\par
\noindent Para2\par
\noindent Para3\par
\bye
